Layouts of pmt_feature_group, pmt_event, handle index derivation and EVT third argument meaning.
Definitions of generic resctrl types rdt_resource, rdt_domain, rdt_l3_mon_domain, rdt_ctrl_domain and event identifiers.
Selection of active MBM correction threshold and factor from the correction table.
Detection and initialization of SNC nodes per cache from CPU identification.
Behavior of resctrl_abmc_set_one_amd, resctrl_get_mon_evt_cfg and domain validation helpers.
Concurrency rules for event_group regions, arch_mbm_state updates and cross CPU ABMC writes.

findings.text: Event group descriptor holds pfname, pfg, force_off, force_on, guid, num_rmid, mmio_size, num_events and trailing evts. The first four are management handles and override flags, the next four are numeric identity and sizing from XML, and evts is a variable length array whose length follows num_events.
Group MMIO size scales with RMID count times event count plus extra status entries, each entry eight bytes wide.

Two built in groups are registered in order energy then perf. Energy uses GUID 0x26696143 with 576 RMIDs and two events PMT_EVENT_ENERGY and PMT_EVENT_ACTIVITY at indexes zero and one with third argument 18. Perf uses GUID 0x26557651 with 576 RMIDs and seven events PMT_EVENT_STALLS_LLC_HIT, PMT_EVENT_C1_RES, PMT_EVENT_UNHALTED_CORE_CYCLES, PMT_EVENT_STALLS_LLC_MISS, PMT_EVENT_AUTO_C6_RES, PMT_EVENT_UNHALTED_REF_CYCLES and PMT_EVENT_UOPS_RETIRED at indexes zero through six with third argument zero. Both reserve three extra status entries in sizing.
Telemetry sample validity lives in the most significant bit, while payload occupies the remaining lower 63 bits.

Package scoped telemetry read takes domid, rmid, arch_priv and val, recovering group context from the event handle. It rejects indexes outside the group mapping with an I/O error after a one time warning. Otherwise it accumulates valid payloads from matching package regions only, ignoring unmapped regions and samples without the validity flag, and reports success with the summed total if at least one valid sample exists, else invalid argument without updating output.
Header fallback offers the same telemetry read signature but unconditionally reports invalid argument.
L3 and L2 code data prioritization enable values are both one.
Memory bandwidth monitoring base width is 24 with vendor offsets 20 for AMD and 8 for Hygon, and the maximum offset is 62 minus the base.
Memory bandwidth allocation linear mode flag has value four.
Monitor data error is signalled in bit 63 and unavailability in bit 62 of the counter readback.
Assignable counter enable is bit zero, extended event selector is bit 31, and event selector is bit zero of its field.
Sub cache distribution enable is bit one.
Per RMID bandwidth state holds chunks and prev_msr as 64 bit accumulations for overflow aware accounting.
Hardware control domain wraps a generic control domain d_resctrl with a pointer ctrl_val to per closid control values.
Hardware L3 monitor domain wraps a generic L3 monitor domain d_resctrl with an array arch_mbm_states of per event bandwidth state pointers indexed by MBM event kind.
Package monitor domain for perf events contains only a generic domain header hdr.
MSR update parameter block carries resource res, domain dom, and low and high halves for the value to write.

Hardware resource descriptor extends a generic resource r_resctrl with closid count num_closid, MSR base msr_base, update callback msr_update, monitor scale mon_scale, counter width mbm_width, and flags cdp_enabled, mbm_cntr_assign_enabled and sdciae_enabled.

Four CPUID leaf decoders share a full 32 bit view plus a split view. The first exposes 5 bit cbm_len, the second 12 bit max_delay, the third 3 reserved bits plus 1 bit noncont, and the fourth 16 bit cos_max.
ABMC configuration word overlays a full register image with fields bw_type 32 bits, bw_src 12 bits, reserved1 3 bits, is_clos 1 bit, cntr_id 5 bits, reserved 9 bits, cntr_en 1 bit and cfg_en 1 bit.
Monitor logging prefixes messages with resctrl, while pseudo lock logging prefixes with the module name.
Global rdt_mon_capable records monitoring availability, and snc_nodes_per_l3_cache defaults to one node per cache.
Correction factor macro converts a decimal factor to fixed point scaled by 1048576 with rounding.

Bandwidth correction uses read only mbm_cf_table of threshold and factor pairs with 28 entries, plus most read mbm_cf_rmidthreshold defaulting to maximum unsigned and most read mbm_cf holding the active factor.
A bandwidth value is scaled only when its RMID exceeds the active threshold, by multiplying with the active factor and shifting right 20 bits, otherwise left unchanged.
Logical to physical RMID translation is identity with a single SNC node per cache, else adds the CPU node modulo node count times the resource RMID count.
Physical RMID read programs MSR_IA32_QM_EVTSEL with event and RMID selectors then reads MSR_IA32_QM_CTR, reporting I/O error on the error bit and invalid argument on the unavailable bit.
Bandwidth state lookup returns null for non MBM events, else the per RMID slot for the event index when the per event array exists.
Single RMID reset clears the event bandwidth state and records any current hardware count as the new baseline.
Reset all clears bandwidth state for every enabled MBM event across all RMIDs of the domain.
Overflow accounting computes the delta between previous and current counter masked to the configured width using 64 bit shifts.
Corrected read accumulates width aware deltas into chunks, applies RMID threshold scaling, updates the baseline and scales by monitor scale, while non MBM events use the raw value scaled.

Architectural RMID read dispatches RDT_RESOURCE_PERF_PKG to telemetry, else validates the L3 monitor domain and non empty CPU mask, translates to a physical RMID, reads hardware, returns scaled corrected data on success, and clears the baseline when data is unavailable.
Counter ID read selects extended ABMC mode with L3 ABMC event and the target counter, then applies the same error and unavailability reporting as RMID reads.
Counter reset clears bandwidth state and records any current counter value as baseline.
Counter read fetches the hardware counter then returns scaled corrected data.
Sub NUMA clustering support is recognized on INTEL_ICELAKE_X, INTEL_SAPPHIRERAPIDS_X, INTEL_EMERALDRAPIDS_X, INTEL_GRANITERAPIDS_X, INTEL_ATOM_CRESTMONT_X and INTEL_ATOM_DARKMONT_X.
ABMC toggling requires CPUs held, traverses monitor domains under RCU, invokes a per domain CPU mask synchronous call, then resets all RMID state per domain.
Counter assignment setter only acts when the resource is assignable and the desired state differs, updating the cached flag after toggling hardware, and always reports success.
Counter assignment query returns the cached hardware resource flag.
Single CPU ABMC configuration writes the supplied configuration word to MSR_IA32_L3_QOS_ABMC_CFG.

Counter configuration builds an ABMC word enabling configuration with requested counter, bandwidth source and assignment state plus event type when assigning, issues it on a domain CPU, then clears bandwidth state because hardware reset the counter.

Prefetch disable mask in prefetch_disable_bits is zero unless Intel family six, with 0xF on INTEL_BROADWELL_X and 0x5 on INTEL_ATOM_GOLDMONT and INTEL_ATOM_GOLDMONT_PLUS, matching documented prefetcher disable bits.

Pseudo lock progresses from cache flush through interrupt and prefetcher disable, saving current association, activating the lock closid, first touching one word per page then one per cache line with speculation barriers, restoring prior association and prefetcher, re enabling interrupts, and finally marking completion and waking waiters. It operates on plr fields kmem, size, line_size and closid, preserving cur_closid and cur_rmid, completing via thread_done and lock_thread_wq.

Latency measurement disables interrupts and prefetchers, warms instruction cache with a dummy timestamp, then per 32 byte offset timestamps a load and traces the delta, finally restoring prefetchers, re enabling interrupts and signalling completion. It uses plr kmem and size with rdtsc_ordered and trace_pseudo_lock_mem_latency, completing via thread_done and lock_thread_wq.
Out of range telemetry index must not be read; implementation warns once and fails with I/O error.
Reads on domains without CPUs or with invalid monitor headers must fail invalid argument without touching hardware, warning once for empty masks.

Pseudo lock and measurement depend on disabled interrupts and prefetchers with direct MSR access to avoid cache pollution, require wbinvd before locking, use barriers against speculative overread, and expect reduced success under KASAN due to extra cached state.
Unavailable counter data clears the stored baseline to avoid stale deltas, and ABMC reconfiguration zeroes state because enabling configuration resets hardware.
Global monitoring capability flag is exposed for cross file checks.
Architecture layer exposes telemetry, RMID and counter read and reset, counter assignment control and configuration, prefetch control, pseudo lock and latency measurement for generic resctrl callers.
Header defines macro _ASM_X86_RESCTRL_INTERNAL_H.
Pseudo lock unit defines CREATE_TRACE_POINTS.
